description: The explicit DISPLAY scope terminator END-DISPLAY (ISO 14.9.11.2) - a COBOL-2002 addition like the whole 2002 scope-terminator wave. The registered end-accept twin had a gate and END-DISPLAY had NONE, so `DISPLAY X END-DISPLAY` was silently accepted at 85 (kb/Work PB134).
source:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. W134D.
DATA DIVISION.
WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
01 W PIC 9(4) VALUE 3.
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    DISPLAY W END-DISPLAY
    STOP RUN.
